title: A locked rule is never retired while its replacement is only proposed
assertion: Superseding a locked rule in favor of a replacement is refused until that replacement is locked, and no answer in `seamspec review` (skip, quit, decline, or the input ending) retires the old rule while its replacement is still proposed.

origin.text: prompt: "yes, start part 1 and propose the rules too". Promised in ADR-20261013-7c2e ("To be proposed").
